caveats: WARM factors are US national averages (energy grid, transport distances, landfill gas recovery). Indonesian landfills mostly lack gas capture, so avoided landfill methane for paper/cardboard/organic is likely HIGHER in reality — these figures are conservative estimates, not measurements.
Metal uses WARM 'Mixed Metals' as the general proxy; steel-only would be 2.04, aluminium 10.09, copper 4.97 kg CO2e/kg. If the app splits metal sub-types, use those.
Organic uses WARM 'Mixed Organics' (food + garden waste composted); food-waste-only composting would be 0.72 kg CO2e/kg.
E-waste uses WARM 'Mixed Electronics'; desktop CPUs would be 1.66, portable devices 1.19, peripherals 0.42 kg CO2e/kg.
method: Saving = (landfill emission factor - recycling emission factor) in MTCO2E per short ton, converted with 1 MTCO2E/short ton = 1.102311 kg CO2e/kg. WARM factors are net lifecycle factors (recycling already includes avoided virgin production).
source: U.S. EPA, Documentation for Greenhouse Gas Emission and Energy Factors Used in the Waste Reduction Model (WARM) - Management Practices Chapters, WARM Version 16, December 2023, EPA-530-R-23-018, Exhibit 1-1
unit: kg CO2e avoided per kg diverted from landfill to recycling (composting for organic)
